problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to load packages onto identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package Alpha: weight 69kg
* Package Bravo: weight 41kg
* Package Charlie: weight 34kg
* Package Delta: weight 36kg
* Package Echo: weight 47kg
* Package Foxtrot: weight 36kg
* Package Golf: weight 47kg
* Package Hotel: weight 69kg
* Package India: weight 59kg
* Package Juliet: weight 66kg
* Package Kilo: weight 46kg
* Package Lima: weight 67kg
* Package Mike: weight 56kg
* Package November: weight 32kg
* Package Oscar: weight 34kg
* Package Papa: weight 39kg
* Package Quebec: weight 58kg
* Package Romeo: weight 33kg
* Package Sierra: weight 52kg
* Package Tango: weight 51kg
* Package Uniform: weight 46kg
* Package Victor: weight 70kg
* Package Whiskey: weight 56kg
* Package X-ray: weight 54kg
* Package Yankee: weight 31kg
* Package Zulu: weight 48kg
* Package Asterisk: weight 45kg

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Load all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
